summary: This document presents the consolidated financial data for Infosys for the third quarter of fiscal 2025. It highlights key metrics such as a 1.7% quarter-over-quarter growth and a 6.1% year-over-year growth in constant currency. The operating margin stands at 21.3%, with an 11.4% increase in earnings per share. Revenue is broken down by business segments, showing financial services as the largest contributor, followed by manufacturing and retail. The geographical revenue distribution indicates North America as the primary market. Client data reveals a total of 1,876 active clients, with significant contributions from top clients. The document provides a comprehensive overview of the company's financial performance and client engagement.
